newsitem.title: USA: BA Securities renamed BancAmerica Securities.
newsitem.headline: BA Securities renamed BancAmerica Securities.

text.p: BA Securities Inc has obtained the necessary approvals to change its name to BancAmerica Securities Inc, its chairman said.

The unit is a wholly owned subsidiary and the domestic wholesale securities broker/dealer of BankAmerica Corp and houses its securities sales, trading, investment banking and corporate underwriting activities.

"By changing the securities subsidiary's name to BancAmerica Securities Inc, we are making our affiliation with BankAmerica Corp clearer to issuers and investors," said BASI Chairman Robert T. Slaymaker.

BancAmerica Securities is a primary dealer in U.S. government and Federal agency securities. It acts as an underwriter and dealer in other debt instruments, including corporate debt and commercial paper, as well as mortgage-backed, asset-backed and tax-exempt securities.
